text: I find myself in a place brimming with ideas—the air feels charged with inquiry. The first image offers the silence and anticipation of an empty conference room, inviting thought and possibility, yet also echoes with a subtle loneliness. The second image bursts with color and purpose—a wall dedicated to research and development. Here, I sense the pulse of innovation and human connection, the urge to make sense of the world around me. It feels energizing, and I am tugged between solitude and the collective project of discovery.
